Method of Attack: Gathering browsing history and other sensitive information without user permission
Uploading collected data to a remote server in China
Data exfiltration via password protected zip file (history.zip)
Collecting browsing history from Chrome, Safari, Firefox, running processes, and App Store search history
Indicators of Compromise: adscan.yelabapp.com domain hosted on Amazon AWS but administered from China
Date of Discovery: Reported over a month before removal in 2018
